No refutation found. I expanded every piece of `cornerStateSum` (statement file work/reviews/def-C-reviewer-input-statement.lean.txt) to primitives and compared it with def:C (sm-3-statesum.tex:1688-1700); on every generic polygon P with n ≥ 3 the Lean value equals the printed C(P).

(1) Sign conventions / ℓ(P). `leftTurns P = (Finset.univ.filter fun i => turn P i = 1).card` (Chirotope.lean:16-17), `turn P i = chi P (i-1) i (i+1)`, `chi P i j k = sign (det (P j - P i) (P k - P i))` (Chirotope.lean:10-14), `det u v = u.1*v.2 - u.2*v.1` (Polygon.lean:16). This is literally τ_i(P) = χ_{i-1,i,i+1}(P), ℓ(P) = #{i : τ_i = 1} of def:chirotope (sm-1-polygons.tex:63-70) with the standard plane orientation; `turn_det` (Chirotope.lean:87) also gives τ_i = sgn det(d_{i-1}, d_i) as in lem:carriers. The global factor `(-1)^leftTurns P` (statement :167) is exactly (−1)^{ℓ(P)}; the inner `(-1)^S.1.card` (statement :169) is (−1)^{|S|}. Both are in ℤ.

(2) Index set. `uniformDecompositions hn hP := (independentSupports hn hP).filter (UniformDecomposition hn hP)` (statement :136-138). `independentSupports = Finset.univ.powerset.filter (interlacementGraph).IsIndepSet` (InterlaceSupports.lean:27-30) = Ind(G_P), and `empty_mem_independentSupports` (:44-47) confirms ∅ ∈ Ind as in def:interlace ("including ∅", sm-1:262). `IsDecomposition hn hP S := S ∈ independentSupports hn hP` (DecompositionDefinition.lean:15-17). `UniformDecomposition S := ∀ q : Component hn hP S, CarrierUniform q`, `CarrierUniform q := ∃ τ : SignType, τ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ j, turn (ccpCornerPolygon hn hP S q) j = τ` (UniformDefinition.lean:27-39) = "all its turns have one sign" / "all its subpolygons are" (def:uniform, sm-3:242-247). The corners of `ccpCornerPolygon` are the marks owned by q that satisfy `IsTrueCorner S` = original vertices and selected visits (CarrierTrueCorners.lean:44-46; CarrierCornerPolygon.lean:341-359), i.e., exactly the printed corners of Q including smoothing corners (def:smoothing, sm-3:22-25), in inherited cyclic order (lem:carriers (i)). The extra `τ ≠ 0` cannot change the index set: on decompositions every carrier corner turn is nonzero (lem:carriers (ii), accepted; `ccpCornerPolygon_regular` CarrierCornerPolygon.lean:679 plus the det ≠ 0 lemma at :670-676), so "one sign" is all +1 or all −1 in both readings. Empty support: `Component hn hP ∅` has exactly one element (`component_card_empty`, CarrierSmoothing.lean:182-186); with no selected visits its corner polygon is P itself (all original vertices are true corners) up to cyclic shift, and `turn`, `leftTurns`, `rotationNumber` are shift-invariant, so S = ∅ contributes (−1)^0 · c(P) exactly as printed. Classical decidability in `filter` is semantically transparent.

(3) Rounded rotation slot. `cornerSlot := 1 - (carrierCrossingCount : ℤ) - |carrierRotationInt|`, `carrierRotationInt := round (carrierRotation)` (statement :61-63, :82-84), `carrierRotation := rotationNumber (ccpCornerPolygon q)` (UniformDefinition.lean:42-44), `rotationNumber P = (Σ principalTurn P i)/(2π)` (RotationNumber.lean:10-11) = rot of lem:rot (sm-1:407-408). `carrierCrossingCount = (carrierCrossings q).card` with `carrierCrossings = {x ∉ S ∧ both visits owned by q}` (CarrierCrossings.lean:56-64) = m_Q of def:smoothing (sm-3:24-26). On a decomposition, `ccpCornerPolygon_regular` (needs `S ∈ independentSupports`) + `rotationNumber_integer` (RotationNumber.lean:45-51) give an exact integer k with `carrierRotation = k`, and `round (k : ℝ) = k` (`round_intCast`), so `carrierRotationInt = r_Q` exactly and `cornerSlot = 1 − m_Q − |r_Q|`; `cornerSlot_cast` (statement :87-92) is the printed real identity, proved. Off decompositions the printed d_Q is undefined and Lean's `round` value is never consumed: `cornerCoefficient`, `cornerHomfly`, `cornerProduct` all require `hS`, and `cornerStateSum` only reaches `cornerProduct` through `isDecomposition_of_mem_uniformDecompositions` (statement :170). So the integer device is harmless.

(4) Coefficient extraction. `cornerCoefficient = coeffAt (cornerSlot) 0 (homfly (positiveLift …))` (statement :103-112), `coeffAt d k f := f.coeff (d, k)` on `R = AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)` (LinkLaurentRing.lean:71-76, 286), with `R.a = single (1,0) 1`, `R.z = single (0,1) 1`, `R.aInv = single (-1,0) 1` (:158-163), so `(d, k)` is a^d z^k and negative d (e.g. d_Q = 1 − m_Q − |r_Q| < 0 for any carrier with m_Q + |r_Q| ≥ 2) is an ordinary exponent. Finsupp evaluation is 0 off the support (`coeffAt_eq_zero_of_notMem_support`, :316-318) = "zero if that monomial is absent". The skein field of `HomflyClauses` is `R.a * H Dp - R.aInv * H Dm = R.z * H D0` (LinkInterfaces.lean:110-111), matching lit:homfly (sm-3:919-920), so the a/z variables are the printed ones; `homfly := Classical.choose lit_homfly` (:131) is the accepted map of lit:homfly.

(5) Positive lift. `positiveLift hn hP S q hS = (carrierShadow …).positiveDiagram _`, `carrierShadow = Shadow.single ⟨ccpCornerCount, ccpCornerCount_ge_three, ccpCornerPolygon q⟩` (LinkPositiveLift.lean:213-222, 596-598), over strand chosen with `det(dir over, dir other) > 0` (:93-97); `IsPositive x ↔ 0 < det(dir over, dir under)`, `sign = sgn det`, `writhe = Σ sign` (LinkDiagram.lean:547-577) = def:positive-lift (sm-3:325-335). Its crossings are identified with `carrierCrossings q` (`carrierCrossingEquiv`, LinkPositiveLift.lean:799) and `positiveLift_writhe_eq_carrierCrossingCount` (:820) gives writhe = m_Q. So `cornerHomfly = H⁺_Q`.

(6) Product and sum. `cornerProduct = ∏ q : Component hn hP S, cornerCoefficient q hS` over the Fintype `Quotient.fintype` of ρ_S-cycles (CarrierSmoothing.lean:124-126, 162-163) = ∏_{Q subpolygon of S} c(Q) (|S|+1 factors by lem:carriers (i)); `cornerStateSum = (-1)^leftTurns P * Σ_{S ∈ uniformDecompositions.attach} (-1)^S.1.card * cornerProduct S.1 _` (statement :166-170) is the printed formula term for term, and the `if`-form over all of Ind(G_P) (statement :174-210) is proved equal, so the two `state_sum` conjuncts (statement :276-288) agree with each other and with def:C.

Non-blocking observations (not refutations): the bundle carries clauses with no printed counterpart in def:C — `rotation_integer` (lem:rot on carriers), `coefficient_with` (the arbitrary-H device of the design record) and the positivity/writhe conjuncts of `positive_lift` (def:positive-lift facts) — all are theorems about accepted definitions, not extra hypotheses, so they neither restrict nor weaken C(P). `CarrierUniform`'s `τ ≠ 0` is redundant on decompositions, as noted. `[NeZero n]` is Prop-valued so the instance threaded through `Component` and the `haveI` inside `independentSupports` are proof-irrelevant. I found no generic polygon or abstract configuration on which the Lean `cornerStateSum hn hP` differs from the printed C(P).

Verdict: not refuted. I attacked each named device and could not produce a concrete input on which the Lean value differs from the printed def:C (source excerpt lines 1688-1700; Lean statement file work/reviews/def-C-reviewer-input-statement.lean.txt, line numbers below refer to it). I did not open work/lean/SM/CornerStateSum.lean.

(1) carrierRotationInt via round (lines 61-63, 67-77). Mathlib `round x = if 2*fract x < 1 then ⌊x⌋ else ⌈x⌉` with `round_intCast : round (k:α) = k` (Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Round.lean:48-49, 85). Where the printed definition applies, S is a decomposition, i.e. `IsDecomposition hn hP S := S ∈ independentSupports hn hP` (DecompositionDefinition.lean:15-17), and `carrierRotation hn hP S q := rotationNumber (ccpCornerPolygon hn hP S q)` (UniformDefinition.lean:42-44) is an integer by `rotationNumber_integer (ccpCornerPolygon_regular hn hP hS q)` (RotationNumber.lean:45-46; CarrierCornerPolygon.lean:679-681). Hence `round carrierRotation = k` exactly: rounding never changes the value on any decomposition. The absolute value is `abs : ℤ → ℤ` applied to that integer rotation (the whole expression `1 - (m:ℤ) - |…|` has type ℤ, so it is not `Int.natAbs`), and `Int.cast_abs` gives `cornerSlot_cast : ((cornerSlot:ℤ):ℝ) = 1 - m_Q - |carrierRotation|` (lines 87-92) — the printed `d_Q = 1 − m_Q − |r_Q|` with `r_Q = rot(Q)` of def:uniform (sm-3:245-246), same left-associated grouping. Off decompositions `carrierRotationInt`/`cornerSlot` are total but are never consumed there: `cornerHomfly`, `cornerCoefficientWith`, `cornerCoefficient`, `cornerProduct` all take `hS`, and the state sum indexes only over `uniformDecompositions ⊆ independentSupports`. Non-blocking.

(2) Threading through attach (lines 136-138, 166-170). `uniformDecompositions := (independentSupports hn hP).filter (UniformDecomposition hn hP)`; `independentSupports = Finset.univ.powerset.filter IsIndepSet` (InterlaceSupports.lean:27-30), i.e. all independent subsets of X(P) including ∅, matching def:interlace (sm-1:262-264) and def:decomposition (sm-3:9-12). `Finset.attach s : Finset {x // x ∈ s}` is in bijection with `s` (a Finset has no duplicates; `Finset.sum_attach`), so every S ∈ Ind(G_P) with S uniform appears exactly once and no other S appears; the classical `DecidablePred` used by `filter` does not affect membership (`Finset.mem_filter`, line 140-144). The summand's dependence on `S.2` is through a Prop (`isDecomposition_of_mem_uniformDecompositions hn hP S.2`), so proof irrelevance makes the value independent of which membership proof is threaded. `(-1)^S.1.card` is (−1)^{|S|}. The product runs over the Fintype `Component hn hP S` = orbits of `smoothingSuccessor` on marks (CarrierSmoothing.lean:124-126, 161-163), i.e. the abstract carriers (cycles) of def:smoothing/conv:selected-visits; each cycle contains ≥1 mark and each mark lies on exactly one cycle, so orbits biject with subpolygons; two distinct cycles cannot trace the same curve for a generic P (their arcs are disjoint subsets of Γ(P) and edge segments do not overlap), so no duplication of Q either. `UniformDecomposition := ∀ q, CarrierUniform` with `CarrierUniform := ∃ τ ≠ 0, ∀ j, turn (ccpCornerPolygon …) j = τ` (UniformDefinition.lean:27-39) is exactly "a decomposition is uniform if all its subpolygons are; Q uniform if all its turns have one sign" (sm-3:243-245), an accepted row.

(3) cornerHomfly on the positive lift (lines 96-98). `homfly := Classical.choose lit_homfly : Diagram → R` (LinkInterfaces.lean:127-131), the map of lit:homfly (sm-3:916-921). `positiveLift hn hP S q hS := (carrierShadow hn hP S q hS).positiveDiagram (carrierShadow_generic …)` (LinkPositiveLift.lean:596-598) is literally the same constant, in the same argument order, that the accepted def:positive-lift row `SM.positive_lift_definition` pins down (PositiveLiftDefinition.lean:85-109: one component whose polygon is `ccpCornerPolygon hn hP S q`; crossings ≃ `carrierCrossings hn hP S q` with equal crossing points; every crossing `IsPositive`, i.e. `0 < det(dir over, dir under)` as printed sm-3:328-331; unique such diagram on that shadow; writhe = `carrierCrossingCount` = m_Q). `carrierShadow = Shadow.single ⟨ccpCornerCount, _, ccpCornerPolygon hn hP S q⟩` (LinkPositiveLift.lean:211-221; LinkDiagram.lean:1589), the corner polygon tracing the same closed curve as the carrier (carriers_clause_ii clause 1, CarrierCornerPolygon.lean:824-826). `Shadow.positiveDiagram` picks by `Classical.choose` a strand with positive determinant against the other (LinkPositiveLift.lean:93-97); by antisymmetry of det and transversality exactly one strand qualifies, so the choice is determined (`eq_positiveDiagram_of_isPositive`, line 128-129). So "its positive lift" is the same object; the bundle field `positive_lift` (lines 220-224) re-records the accepted clauses. The `hS` argument is a Prop, so proof-irrelevant.

(4) "Zero if absent" (lines 103-131; bundle 239-250). `R := AddMonoidAlgebra ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)` with `R.a := single (1,0) 1`, `R.z := single (0,1) 1` (LinkLaurentRing.lean:71-76, 159-161), so exponent `(d,k)` is `a^d z^k`; `coeffAt d k f := f.coeff (d,k)` (line 286), Finsupp evaluation, and `coeffAt_eq_zero_of_notMem_support` is `Finsupp.notMem_support_iff` (lines 316-318). `cornerCoefficient = coeffAt (cornerSlot …) 0 (homfly (positiveLift …))` puts d_Q in the a-slot and 0 in the z-slot, as printed; the value is 0 when `(d_Q,0)` is outside the support — exactly "the coefficient of a^{d_Q} z^0 (zero if that monomial is absent)". The added converse (nonzero ↔ in support, lines 127-131, 249-250) is a Finsupp tautology, non-blocking.

(5) Global sign and remaining clauses. `leftTurns P := (univ.filter (turn P · = 1)).card`, `turn P i := chi P (i-1) i (i+1)` (Chirotope.lean:13-17) = ℓ(P) = #{i : τ_i(P)=1} of def:chirotope (sm-1:69-70); bundle `left_turns` (271-272). The printed `C(P)` is literally the first conjunct of `state_sum` (276-283); the second (dite over all of Ind) is the proved consumer form for lem:C-X1 (sm-3:1787-1795), which itself defines its `c(L)` by reference to def:C, so no circularity or extra content. Bundle clauses without a printed counterpart — `coefficient_with` (arbitrary H, design record), the converse in `coefficient_absent`, the second clause of `uniform_index_set`, the `if`-form of `state_sum` — are all true consequences of the definitions and impose no restriction (non-blocking). No printed clause is missing: types carry "subpolygon Q of a decomposition of the generic polygon P" (`q : Component hn hP S`, `hS : IsDecomposition`, `hP : Generic P`, `hn : 3 ≤ n`); `positive_lift`, `rotation_integer`/`slot`, `coefficient`, `coefficient_absent`, `uniform_index_set`, `product`, `left_turns`, `state_sum` cover H⁺_Q, d_Q, c(Q), the absence clause and C(P).

Residual (non-blocking) observations only: `carrierRotationInt` and `cornerSlot` carry junk values off decompositions where the printed d_Q is undefined; `CarrierUniform` demands a nonzero common turn sign, which coincides with "all turns have one sign" because carrier corner turns of decompositions are nonzero (carriers_clause_ii) and def:uniform is an accepted row. Neither yields a decomposition S or carrier Q on which the Lean `cornerStateSum` or `cornerCoefficient` differs from the printed value.
